title: A Hopf Algebraic Theory of the Quantum Magnusian
summary: We develop a Hopf-algebraic theory of graph coefficients arising in the quantum Magnus expansion. At the classical level, the expansion is governed by directed trees, whereas its quantum counterpart involves loop graphs, multiple edges, and several types of edge data. We introduce a contraction Hopf algebra of mixed quivers containing these diagrams and closed under contraction. On this algebra we define a character $e$ from normalized linear-extension data, directed-tadpole factors, and a prescription for undirected edges, and let $ω$ be its convolution inverse.
